notes:
CRM notes / POC summary:
- Company background: Sable Reserve AI provides real-time risk scoring and trade surveillance for mid-to-large brokers. Heavy tokenized document ingestion, frequent rerank workflows. Regulated finance environment.
- Primary ask: evaluate Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and strict latency SLOs; explore Private (VPC/on-prem) for data residency.
- Workload profile: long-context reranking + embeddings for daily indexing + chat assistant for traders. Peak patterns: 3x spikes during market open (9:30–10:30 ET).
- Targets captured on 2026-01-12 call: p95 latency <= 120ms for short-chat (<=2048 tokens), p95 latency <= 300ms for 8k-16k context rerank steps; sustained throughput target 250 tokens/sec per tenant with burst to 800 tokens/sec for 10 minutes.
- Reserved GPU planning: initial conservative sizing = 4x A100 equivalent GPUs (reserved), scale plan to add 2 GPUs under burst policy. Finance prefers 3-year commit but wants annual review.
- SLA negotiation points: uptime target 99.9% with 4-hour incident response; credits sliding scale based on missed SLOs; customer requests explicit fallback policy to hosted-compatible model variants in case of capacity events.
- Model-specific tuning requests: support for 32k context models for rare deep-dive queries; prefer mixed-precision quantization (INT8-like q4_0 baseline) but require quality regression testing vs FP16 on key eval set. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization profile selection and batch size heuristics.
- Batching & KV cache notes: want automatic continuous batching but hard cap on latency tail; KV cache persistence per tenant with TTL=24h, eviction policy configurable. For reranking flows, prefer smaller micro-batches (batch size 8–16) and aggressive prefix caching for repeated queries.
- Observed POC issues: default kernel selection caused a memory spike at 16k context; SE suggested alternative kernel + compile flags, and to try q4_0 with per-layer fallback to FP16 for attention layers.
- Security/compliance: SSO via SAML required, KMS integration for model keys, audit logs retained for 2 years, data residency in us-east-1 only.
- Customer quotes / paraphrases: "we need predictable tail latency during market open — outages cost real dollars", "no regressions allowed after quantization, provide automatic rollback if eval drops".
- Risks: finance pushback on long-term commit; QA wants automated regression alerts tied to eval prompt set; network team insists on throughput verification over customer VPC.
- Next technical steps (from SE call): 1) Run quantization A/B on core rerank model with Redwood Optimize tool; 2) Re-run POC with KV-cache enabled and micro-batching for rerank; 3) Provide a reserved GPU sizing report (ops to propose 4 reserved GPUs, 2 hot-standby for burst).
- Next commercial steps: finalize SLA language (legal), produce pricing worksheet for 1-, 2-, 3-year commit scenarios, align on forecasted QPS for committed capacity.
- Short notes / shorthand: "POC metrics attached in Drive", "need perf cert for 32k ctx", "ask: explicit fallback to lower-cost model w/ auto-routing"
- Reference artifacts: drive:pricing-deck-v2, sla-draft-v1, perf-report-2026-02-25; Jira tickets INFRA-7842 (perf anomaly), SEC-1199 (KMS integration).
